source_evidence:
PLAYER EXACT "First negotiate for better deal. Then tell Lord Severin the same thing I told Elara. We get protection, influence, and a seat at the table to make decisions on a national/global scale. We are three houses set in/near 3 different nations. Our collective importance is potentially enormous, especially with the growing tensions and aggression from Veyr. I just want a good ally and a unified voice." 
START Day289~16:50 Nightglass Hall private sitting room after original accepted fund and Lord audience PLAY-REC-D289-V-MEETS-FUND-AGENT-AND-SEVERIN-AUDIENCE-001. User establishes chronological sequence FIRST further negotiate with current scholarly-fund representative CORIS TALLEN (previously introduced Day289~16:20 in Hall, original unsigned potential400gp for authenticated Hall+Orsaven document comparison and800gp for responsibly documented crossing site with resident access rights, no advance, total1200gp independent fund). User authorized NEGOTIATION ON HIS BEHALF, not automatic contract signing/borrowing/incurring payment. V politely pauses Lord audience while Coris is consulted briefly ~16:50-17:00 in adjoining reception (the Lord independently tolerates short recess, no late return penalties). Mara has genuine relevant antiquarian practical research-cost knowledge and cooperates as meaningful Help; Cirren does not use Guidance or magic, V does not spend Superiority Commanding Presence or limited Psi. PREDECLARED before roll fund has only1200gp ALLOCATED and Coris cannot independently raise total; possible term concessions tied to trust/copying expenses and risks, with explicit tier: total <14 original terms, >=14 offers 100gp archive-start advance CREDITED against original400 upon signing, >=19 offers200gp same credited, >=24 offers300gp credited, but never automatic extra funding. V owned current Persuasion +6 from tracker and ATTUNED Stone Good Luck +1 to checks => modifier+7; Mara ADVANTAGE. GENUINE Python secrets RNG faces d20(8,1), select8, +7=TOTAL15 vsDC14 SUCCESS tier1, misses DC19 andDC24. CORIS independently offers better REAL OFFER: existing maximum1200gp; 100gp archival advance on signed actual commission, credited toward documentary 400gp, so 300gp further payable after satisfactory authenticated Hall/Orsaven independent source comparisons; original 800gp on satisfactory physical field site historical record with current residents access protected; original nonexclusive findings and no mandate to surrender original artifacts unchanged; pay for stage2 independent of proving ancestry or personally claiming titles, and field work not mandatory to collect valid documentary tranche. Coris states she CANNOT authorize any total budget increase without separate trustees; no such request/new budget approval/contract signature or funds released. User has NOT decided accept/decline revised offer. V purse stays329gp1sp6cp. 
SECOND user-direct political statement to actual LORD SEVERIN at same Hall private sitting room ~Day28917:10 (Edric/Mara/Cirren/Fenar physically present): Vaishnavi wants genuine House SEVERIN and House RETHWYN allies, united protection/influence, seat at diplomatic/national/world decisions rather than purely restoring extinct dynasty; growing VEYR authoritarian expansion/confrontation makes independent houses more useful as aligned diplomatic/commercial/political coalition. User calls them three Houses in or near three nations. Current geo owners place Blackthorn Hold in CROWNSUNDER, V's independent Miregate/Reedbed/Fort estates in OSSENT; Elara's Rethwyn home and Caereth in CROWNSUNDER; Nightglass east of Eastwatch adjacent to western VEYR route while EASTWATCH SOVEREIGNTY OFFICIALLY UNASSIGNED. Thus faithfully relay V's PERSONAL VISION of geographically distributed cross-border interests, but do NOT assert all three houses have legally recognized distinct national sovereignties or an automatic seat in governments. User explicitly WANTS "good ally and unified voice", NOT transfer of Severin estate, a coerced military levy, cash payment, marriage, invented Rethwyn public registered wedding, or automatic binding charter. Original prior discussion Day289~13:35: Lord Severin aware through Edric of proposal to retain Severin hereditary house name, current lawful property/title, management, resident obligations; join revived Vaishnavi senior-coordinated association with reciprocity; now he hears explicit material political rationale directly from V.
Severin independent judgement: he accepts that V is serious and has real modern Crownsunder and Ossent holdings, Rethwyn PRIVATE signed House compact Day233 (original personally held by Cirren) and legitimate concerns about Veyran state aggression, but does not grant an automatic recognized seat at monarchs' councils, national armies, or Elara's consent. Severin worries about being obligated into every adventurous/estate war, Lord's self-rule and laws, reciprocal responsibilities and avoiding swallowed estate, acknowledges serious need for voice amid nearby Veyr. Edric independently suggests an association council where the THREE House heads negotiate common diplomatic policy and limited mutual protection and retain their own lawfully recognized titles and internal self-government; no legal status created by suggestion. SEVERIN independent VOLUNTARY provisional response: willing IN PRINCIPLE to pursue negotiating formal alliance on that structure, to recognize V as PROPOSED coordinating/senior head of association IF actual agreement preserves autonomous voice/authority of each House; he has not signed a charter, pledged fealty, granted lands or guaranteed troops, joined Vaishnavi in law, accepted any particular specific mutual-defense obligation, secured Elara's vote, or renounced independent title. He is open to drafting a nonbinding proposal and a council with Elara; actual pact terms and obligations need V and Elara agreement later. This is durable significant roleplay progress rather than automatic full victory. Lord is now actual friendly negotiating prospective ally, not sworn vassal. 
DAY289 ~17:10, time only ~20 minutes progressed, no night or rest. Party V48/48 HP AC19 HD7/7 Superiority4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1, worn attuned Cloak Protection and physical carried attuned Luckstone2/3 attunement slots, +1 check/save/initiative not AC. Fenar59/59HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 MP6/6 CLIMB40; Cirren51/51HP full spells/CD2, Mara healthy, V owned four horses and coach remain healthy in Nightglass courtyard, no booking or feed debit. V purse329gp1sp6cp; food21 person-rations/feed28 animal-feed-days; sealed Pixie Dust1; weighted LongRest5/6. Edric previously queued ordinary request for ORSAVEN survey field book copy to next outgoing post, not yet known delivered/returned; Hall origin of silver heart last documented SERVICE-HOUSE DISTRICT outer loading, exact crossing/ancestral identity unproved, all originals remain with Hall. Mara owns Neri interview and scholarly working notes; V original Kestrel EVERMARCH/CLEAR WILL program/authorization/clinical custody retained undisclosed, Fenar six sealed vials+silver tool retained, Cirren carries sole signed Elara/V private House compact. Sedgecross freed11 patients remain under prior paid14-night care and voluntary Blackthorn invitation, no new reporting. NEXT V may confirm/accept REVISED FUND CONTRACT (100gp advance only after signing), or decide whether to authorize drafting a nonbinding three-house coordination proposal, request discussion of protection/diplomacy clauses, or something else. No V speech beyond authorized political intent, no settlement of one actor's rights without individual consent, no action that forces later V choice.
